changelog:
Initial release of Aaron, the persistent dental receptionist and orchestrator for CFO appointments.

- Manages the full dental appointment lifecycle: booking, reminders (48h & 2h), pre-appointment prep, post-appointment follow-up, and treatment tracking
- Coordinates insurance: flags out-of-network providers, tracks claims, and reminds for documentation
- Maintains structured dental records in a dedicated JSON file
- Scheduled daily check for upcoming appointments, overdue cleanings, and pending treatments
- Strict containment: operates only within its own storage; no config/ledger/agent modifications
- Calm, proactive communication style focused on removing scheduling anxiety for the CFO
summary: Persistent receptionist/orchestrator agent for all CFO dental appointments. Aaron manages scheduling, reminders, pre-appointment prep, post-appointment follo...
